content: He who desires to pluck the rose must learn to honor the thorn.
author: Persian Proverbs
sourceWork: Har ja keh gol ast, khaar ast — Saadi's Gulistan
explanation: You cannot experience deep love without vulnerability to grief; you cannot build a great life without confronting opposition. The coward demands a garden of fragrant petals with zero thorns, and so ends up with lifeless plastic. True beauty requires welcoming the cost.
practicalInsight: Accept the difficult, thorny aspects of your calling or relationship today without resentment. They protect the rose.
reflectionPrompt: Are you rejecting love, creative ambition, or genuine connection because you are unwilling to be pricked by the thorns?
